benefit: Dill (Anethum graveolens) provides nectar and pollen for hoverflies, lacewings, and parasitic wasps that suppress cucumber beetles, aphids, and squash bugs. Flowers also draw bees during cucumber bloom for improved fruit set.

members.title: Dill on cucumber row ends
members.body: Direct-sow dill at the ends and middle of cucumber rows. Allow some plants to flower for full beneficial-insect support.
